messages.subject: exporting factorloadings (cfa) to spss
parts: How can I export my cfa results (factorloadings) from LAVAAN to SPSS?

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: exporting factorloadings (cfa) to spss
parts:
On 05/12/2015 04:57 PM, Silke Vanslambrouck wrote:
> How can I export my cfa results (factorloadings) from LAVAAN to SPSS?

As an example:

library(lavaan)
example(cfa)

LAMBDA <- lavTech(fit, "est", add.labels = TRUE)$lambda
write.csv(LAMBDA, file = "c:/tmp/myLoadings.csv")


This will create a file 'myLoadings.csv' in your 'c:/tmp' directory.
Next, you can 'import' this csv file in SPSS.

Yves.
